description: Manage Apple container (native Linux containers on macOS) in VS Code: containers, images, networks, volumes and system services
viewsContainer.title: Apple Container
welcome.cliMissing:
The container CLI was not found. Install Apple container (e.g. `brew install container`) or set `appleContainer.path` in settings.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22appleContainer.path%22)
welcome.serviceStopped:
The container system service is not running.
[Start Service](command:appleContainer.system.start)
welcome.noContainers:
No containers.
[Run a Container from an Image](command:appleContainer.image.run)
config.path: Path to the `container` CLI. By default it is looked up in PATH, `/opt/homebrew/bin` and `/usr/local/bin`.
config.refreshInterval: Auto refresh interval (seconds) while a view is visible. Set to `0` to disable.
config.execShell: Shell to run inside the container for `Attach Shell`.
config.sshUser: User to log in as when opening a container with **Open in Remote-SSH**. Leave empty to use the container's own user (image `USER` or `--user`, root by default). If the container has no `sshd`, `openssh-server` is installed with its package manager.
config.devcontainerMemory: Memory for dev containers (for example `4G` or `512M`). Apple container gives each container 1 GB unless told otherwise, while Docker containers are not limited, so dev containers get this much, or `hostRequirements.memory` from `devcontainer.json` when that is larger. Empty uses the Apple container default. Applies when a dev container is created or rebuilt.
config.logTail: Number of trailing lines to show when viewing logs. `0` shows all.
welcome.noRegistries:
Not logged in to any registry.
[Log In to Registry](command:appleContainer.registry.login)
config.composePath: Path to the `container-compose` CLI used by Compose Up / Down.
config.statsInterval: Sampling interval (seconds) of the stats chart.
config.insecureRegistries: Registries reached over plain http when pulling or pushing, as `host` or `host:port`. `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` always are.
